title: Simply supported beam
sentence: A beam pinned at one end and rollered at the other, under a uniform downward pressure — the textbook counterpart to the cantilever.
theory: The two classic results: $\delta_{mid} = \dfrac{5wL^4}{384EI}$ and $M_{max} = \dfrac{wL^2}{8}$. The roller is what makes it statically determinate — pin both ends and the beam picks up axial force as it sags, which the closed form does not include.
